main_idea: BAR covers 5,161 legal cases across 28 practice areas.
ideas: BAR spans 5,161 legal cases and 28 practice areas.
BAR is a shared evaluation of end-to-end legal work.
summary: Branding, a decorative grid, and a redundant caption add clutter around the case and practice-area counts.

regions.label: red
regions.name: header branding
regions.reason: The logo and benchmark name add branding without helping read the scale.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: main headline
regions.reason: States the central claim, though it could be more specific.

regions.label: red
regions.name: grid decoration
regions.reason: The faint grid is decorative and does not encode data.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: case area marks
regions.reason: The marks form the graphic’s scale illustration, though their quantities are not individually labeled.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: case count
regions.reason: The number and category label communicate the benchmark’s case volume.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: area count
regions.reason: The number and category label communicate the breadth of practice areas.

regions.label: red
regions.name: supporting caption
regions.reason: Restates the evaluation theme without adding information to the counts.
